sources_quoted.quote: "Ability recasts are scheduled on one shared timeline ... an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed and no other cast is in progress, and a cast counts when it *starts* within the window (`_schedule_shared_casts`). sources_quoted.use: Gives the cast-count identity N = floor(T_eff / c) + 1 for epochs 0, c, 2c, … counted by cast start.

sources_quoted.use: A *coupled* scenario truncates the nominal window at the attacker's death, so the effective rotation window can be far shorter than the nominal 60 s.

It does NOT pin whether the per-ability number under `aoe` is a cast count, an AoE weight, or a target count — the residual ambiguity behind this receipt's medium confidence.

independent_computation.step_1_leaf_should_exist: Syndra Q carries "spellEffects": "Aoe" and damages "nearby enemies" in a 210-unit radius (S1). Any per-ability node grouped under `aoe` must therefore contain Q (as it must W and E, and must not contain R, which is "spell"/Unit-targeted, S4). The prior state — Q absent from the aoe node — is contradicted by the cached wiki data, so <absent> is not defensible as the correct pin.

step_2_magnitude_as_cast_count.identity: N = floor(T_eff / c) + 1, cast epochs 0, c, 2c, … counted when the cast starts inside the window (S5)
step_2_magnitude_as_cast_count.c_no_haste: c = 7.0 s (S2; affectedByCdr=false, so item haste does not apply)
step_2_magnitude_as_cast_count.window_that_yields_5: N = 5 ⟺ 4c ≤ T_eff < 5c ⟺ 28 s ≤ T_eff < 35 s at c = 7 s, or 21.54 s ≤ T_eff < 26.92 s at c = 5.3846 s
step_2_magnitude_as_cast_count.reconciliation: The scenario lives under `coupled_scenarios`, and a coupled fight is scored only up to the main participant's own death (S6). A 60 s nominal window truncated by Syndra dying at ~28–35 s (or ~21.5–27 s if R rank 3's Dark Sphere haste is active) yields exactly 5 Q casts. 5 is therefore inside the band the sourced 7 s cooldown permits; it is only inconsistent with the *untruncated* 60 s reading (which would be 9, or 12 with R3 haste).

independent_computation.step_3_magnitude_as_target_or_weight: If the number is instead an AoE multiplicity/weight (F3's "AoE weight", S8), the wiki caps nothing: Q's notes place no limit on enemies hit inside the 210-unit radius (S1), so the maximum number of enemy champions a single Dark Sphere can hit is the enemy team size, 5. 5 is again admissible and is the wiki-permitted maximum.
independent_computation.conclusion: Under every semantics I can source for a per-ability number under `rotation/aoe`, 5 is admissible: it is the exact cast count of a 7 s-cooldown ability over a coupled window truncated at ~28–35 s, and it is the maximum champion count an uncapped AoE can hit. No cached wiki quantity contradicts it, while the previous state (Q absent from an aoe node) IS contradicted by Q's "spellEffects": "Aoe" flag.

falsifiable_caveat: The one reading under which 5 is wrong is 'number of Q casts over the full, untruncated 60 s window' — that value is 9 at the sourced 7 s cooldown, or 12 with R rank 3's +30 Dark Sphere ability haste. If the leaf is defined as an untruncated-window cast count, the correct value is 9/12 and this verdict flips to both_wrong. Because the scenario is explicitly a *coupled* scenario (scored to the attacker's death, §3.1), I judge that reading the least likely of the three.
stability_note: If the leaf is the coupled cast count, its value is a step function of Syndra's death time (it changes whenever the death time crosses a 7 s multiple). That makes it a brittle golden pin — an independent argument for retiring the leaf rather than for re-pinning it, and it does not depend on which of the two candidate values is 'right'.
